Subject: Bank change request + portal admin update

Hi Naomi / Laura,

We completed onboarding with Redwood last month and need to update our vendor record to point payments to our new banking provider. Can you confirm next steps and what evidence you need to process this? I attached the signed Vendor Banking Change Form and a voided check.

A couple of specifics: 
- New ACH account is set up with First Ridge Bank (routing 121000358 / acct ****4521) — see attached.
- We'd like the change to be effective for invoices with PO PO-88412 (expected payment cycle: net 30, invoice submitted 2027-06-25).
- Also, please update our portal admin to the new AP lead: Maria Gonzalez (maria.gonzalez@acmemed.com). She will receive PO notifications and submit invoices.

Files attached: acme_banking_change_form_20270619.pdf, acme_voided_check_0627.png, acme_w9_20270619.pdf

Let me know if you need a secure upload (DocuSign or portal) for the banking details. We prefer a payment-test ACH of $0.01 before live payments if possible.

Thanks,
Sophie Lee
Accounts Payable Manager
Acme Medical

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending this over and welcome again. 

Confirmed we received the Vendor Banking Change Form and the W-9. Before Finance makes the switch we need:
- A copy of the voided check (you attached a PNG; that works) or a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the new account.
- Confirmation of the effective date for the change (you mentioned invoices submitted 2027-06-25). Please confirm the earliest invoice number/date to apply the new routing to.
- Approval from your contracting contact for the portal admin change (we need the legal/ops contact copied in on that confirmation).

Marcus — can you advise on the internal validation steps for ACH swaps and whether a $0.01 micro-deposit is our preference or if we can do a zero-dollar verification? Also, if Finance needs the DocuSign envelope rather than attachments in email, say so and I'll ask Sophie to re-send via secure link.

Sophie — once Marcus confirms, we will: 1) record the change in the vendor master, 2) schedule a payment-method change ticket with AP, and 3) update the portal PO routing to Maria Gonzalez as requested.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bank change request + portal admin update

Thanks Naomi / Sophie — quick note from Finance: 

1) We require one of the following to change ACH routing: signed banking change form + voided check OR signed banking change form + bank letter on letterhead. The PNG you sent is fine but please also provide the bank letter if available; it speeds the internal approval.
2) We can perform a $0.01 micro-deposit verification (our standard) to confirm the account routing prior to scheduling live payments. Please confirm if Acme will confirm receipt of the micro-deposit in the portal.
3) Effective date: Finance prefers to apply the change on the first AP cycle after micro-deposit verification. If you want it applied to invoices dated 2027-06-25, we will attempt to align but need the micro-deposit cleared by EOD 2027-06-22.

Action items for Sophie: send bank letter (if available) and confirm Maria Gonzalez's full contact details (phone + Redwood portal username/email match). Once we have that we will create a change ticket (internal ref: PO-88412-ACH) and schedule the micro-deposit.

Sophie — feel free to upload sensitive docs to DocuSign (link below) and reply with the DocuSign ID rather than sending attachments via email.

DocuSign upload: https://app.docusign.com/algd3S8/acme-banking-change
Internal ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PO-88412

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Financial Operations | Redwood Inference
